rounds.title: Progress steps baseline
rounds.note: First drawing of the SDK progress steps (et-progress-steps, et-progress-step), drawn by their mock from @ethlete/components/design: a checkout row (complete, current, two upcoming), an outcome row (success, warning, error, upcoming), a row with descriptions, a vertical column, and the steps written as links with hover, active and focus-visible on an upcoming and a complete step. This product registers no success theme, so success keeps the brand theme (as the component does without one). Fixed numbers: upcoming numbers and labels in the muted surface text 7.81:1 light, 6.94:1 dark; the current label in the full text at weight 600, 17.93:1 light, 17.18:1 dark; the current number in ink, 5.48:1 light, 13.50:1 dark; outcome labels in ink, success 5.48:1 / 13.50:1, warning 7.09:1 / 8.35:1, danger 6.47:1 / 6.48:1 (light / dark); icons on their fill: check on mint 15.82:1, triangle on warning 5.63:1, cross on danger 4.83:1. Today on light the mint parts vanish against the page: the complete and success marker fill, its 2px edge, the current step's 2px ring, the filled connector and the hover ring are all mint, 1.33:1 (dark 13.50:1); warning 3.19:1 light, 5.63:1 dark; danger 4.83:1 light, 3.71:1 dark. The focus ring is the 2px primary, 1.33:1 on light (dark 13.50:1). Edges, numbers only (Q98 open): the upcoming marker ring and the empty connector in the surface border, 1.26:1 light, 1.73:1 dark. Q101 does not arise: a link or button step has no hover fill, its hover only recolours the marker ring and label. Variant b applies decided rules Q88 (focus ring in --et-theme-color-ink-solid) and Q99 rule a (ink for the edges of mint fills, the current ring, the filled connector and the hover ring), ink following the scheme. Because b adds a visible edge around the fills, Q102 arises: variant c is b with the edges and connector in light-dark(ink, primary), dark as today. Variant a shows today. Not this round's question: the faint upcoming ring and empty connector (Q98); the muted colours; that the focus ring of a horizontal step boxes the label and crosses the connector.

a.note: Today: marker fill, marker edge, current ring, filled connector, hover ring and focus ring all in primary. Mint 1.33:1 against the light page (dark 13.50:1), warning 3.19:1 / 5.63:1, danger 4.83:1 / 3.71:1 (light / dark). Text and icons as in the round note.

b.note: Pick. Decided rules Q88 and Q99 rule a, not a new call: focus ring, marker edges of resolved and current steps, the filled connector and the link hover ring in --et-theme-color-ink-solid; fills stay primary. Light: mint parts 5.48:1 against the page (edge against the mint fill 4.13:1), warning 7.09:1 (2.23:1 against its fill), danger 6.47:1 (1.34:1 against its fill); focus ring 5.48:1. Dark: ink is mint, so brand steps and the focus ring stay at 13.50:1, unchanged; warning and danger take their lighter ink, 8.35:1 and 6.48:1 against the page, a lighter ring around the fill (1.48:1 and 1.75:1 against it) and a lighter connector. Picked to match the avatar and badge picks: ink follows the scheme. Q102 open; if dark should stay as today, take c.

c.note: b with the marker edges, connector and hover ring in light-dark(ink, primary): light equal to b (mint 5.48:1, warning 7.09:1, danger 6.47:1 against the page); dark as today (mint 13.50:1, warning 5.63:1, danger 3.71:1, no lighter ring). The focus ring stays in ink in both schemes (Q88), equal to today in dark for brand. It keys on color-scheme, not on the surface; that is my reading of rule a, not a decided rule (Q102).
